protocol.order: cyclically rotate policy order by instance seed and measurement round
protocol.portfolio_constraint: makespan no greater than shared-successor baseline; select least loss then makespan; baseline is always eligible
protocol.scope: synthetic reserved-path constant-deficit DAG scheduling; scale means number of flow groups, not WAN nodes
protocol.selection: critical-path, weighted-critical and fixed three-plan portfolio defined before inspecting holdout; no holdout tuning
protocol.timing: perf_counter_ns; every invocation includes compile and all portfolio plans; imports, instance generation and independent validation are excluded
protocol.units: planner wall time in ms; recovery in uncalibrated ticks; do not add them

scope: Synthetic task-DAG mechanism benchmark; measured planner milliseconds and uncalibrated recovery ticks remain separate. Full rollout was not run above 20 flow groups according to the predeclared protocol.
source_of_evidence: Decoded GitHub Actions job logs, authenticated run metadata and artifact metadata
